title: Start Here: reading order and orientation
note: Index: orientation, the 11-step reading order with one line each, and a closing note on canon and dating.

title: The Gospel of Thomas
note: 114 of 114 sayings, numbered in the margin. Lambdin translation (Robinson, Nag Hammadi Library in English), openly posted at earlychristianwritings.com.

title: The Gospel of Mary
note: Manuscript pages 7-10 and 15-19 only, as extant; the two lacunae (pages 1-6 and 11-14) are marked in the text. Page numbers in the margin. Mattison public-domain translation.

title: The Gospel of Truth
translator: Harold W. Attridge and George W. MacRae
note: Continuous text; the source has no chapter or verse divisions, so none were imposed. Attridge & MacRae translation (Robinson).

title: The Apocryphon of John
translator: Michael Waldstein and Frederik Wisse (long recension)
note: LONG recension (NHC II,1 and IV,1), per instruction to use the long version. Waldstein & Wisse translation; marginal numbers follow Karen King sectioning.

title: The Gospel of Philip
note: Sayings numbered 1-100, following the paragraph divisions of the Isenberg translation; some editions divide this text into 127 sayings, so external cross-references can differ.

title: The Gospel of Judas
note: Codex Tchacos 3, manuscript pages 33-58, all present and marked. Mattison public-domain translation; the translator's editorial section headings were removed, the text itself is unaltered.

title: The Hypostasis of the Archons
note: Continuous text, no internal numbering in the source. Bentley Layton translation (Robinson).

title: On the Origin of the World
note: Continuous text; the treatise has no ancient title and is named from its opening words. Bethge & Layton translation (Robinson).

title: The Thunder, Perfect Mind
note: Verse and line divisions preserved: unindented lines and indented continuation lines follow the source dt/dd structure. MacRae translation (Robinson).

title: The Dialogue of the Savior
note: Lacunose text; gaps are kept in brackets exactly as in the source. Stephen Emmel translation (Robinson).

title: The Gospel of the Egyptians
note: The NAG HAMMADI Gospel of the Egyptians (The Holy Book of the Great Invisible Spirit), NHC III,2 and IV,2 - NOT the Greek infancy gospel. See REPORT.md: the brief cited "VI,3", which is a different tractate (Authoritative Teaching).
